limitations: Human versus AI is inferred from prompt and agent hook boundaries; edits made concurrently between boundaries can be ambiguous.
Estimated wasted tokens allocate a turn's observed usage in proportion to AI-added lines later superseded; providers do not report token-to-line causality.
Token deltas are assigned to the turn active at the reporting hook; provider telemetry reported late can shift usage to the following prompt.
Multiple writes between native hook callbacks appear as one rewrite event; agents without post-tool hooks expose turn-level rather than tool-level revisions.
